answer: Tenure-weighted influence ramp resists sybils: an identity's voting and earning weight grows sublinearly with its verified age, starting near zero and reaching full only after many epochs of continuous standing. A trellis of freshly minted fakes carries almost no weight however many you wander in — mass creation is instantly diluted to near-nothing. To matter, every fake must independently survive the full copper-slow ramp, converting bulk creation into per-head calendar time an attacker cannot compress. Precondition: age counts only verified, continuously-active epochs.
